[[Ravenshire Gloves]] | previous = [[Assaulting Freyshear Keep]] }} == Objectives == 'Save' Genn, and recover the Greymane Crown for Lord Darius Ravenwood at Ravenshire in Gilneas. * [[The Greymane Crown]] == Description == The entirety of Gilneas stands at our side! The tyranny of the royalists can no longer be allowed to stand! If this nation is to ever recover from the darkness, then we must hold fast, and strike even faster still! The Greymane Crown must be recovered if our dream is ever to be realized. Enter Gilneas City. Fight your way through his most loyal soldiers. End the Harlows, and reclaim the Greymane birthright. A new king and a new beginning awaits us, . ==Rewards== * 7400 [[XP]] == Progress == Be brave adventurer, the city itself has struggled through civil strife as we have. == Completion == The end of an era is upon us. A darkness has been lifted on this day, and with it, a new hope emerges from the clouds. A ray of light for all to see. Liam Greymane shall be named king and his reign shall bring prosperity to the people who have suffered for so long! ==Notes== ;Upon completion :'''Lord Darius Ravenwood yells:''' Tyranny has been defeated this day! Our land has been freed from the evil that has corrupted our forests, and murdered countless innocents. A new king has been crowned, glory to Gilneas! ==Progression== {{Gilneas Civil War}}
